# FROZEN -- do not edit. The direct fields `struct Interpreter`
# (src/runtime/mod.rs) had when this list was cut, one name per line.
# ADR-10779 D4: `make check-interp-fields` fails on a field that is neither
# listed here nor in a file under scripts/interp-fields.d/.
#
# A name that is no longer a field is simply ignored. A PR that extracts a
# subsystem allows its new holder field by ADDING a file
# scripts/interp-fields.d/<subsystem>.txt -- never by editing this file, which
# is what kept parallel PRs from merging when it held a single count.
